description.value: A four-season resort on the Trans-Canada between Shuswap Lake and Revelstoke, set along the Eagle River with outdoor hot pools (40°C soak to 8°C cold plunge) open every day of the year; tenting and unserviced sites share the grounds with full RV hookups and cabins, so expect a resort atmosphere and fees.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active, year-round resort in Malakwa, BC with RV/tenting sites, forest cabins, and outdoor hot pools; OSM and website agree on address (6162 Trans-Canada Highway), phone (250-836-4097), and domain. The website mentions 'tenting & RV sites including 30/50 amp sites with water and sewer, pull through sites and unserviced sites' and activities including mountain biking and hiking, relevant to touring cyclists. OSM name 'Crazy Creek Hot Pools Resort' differs from the consistent website branding 'Crazy Creek Resort', flagged in concerns.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Crazy Creek Hot Pools Resort' but the website consistently brands as 'Crazy Creek Resort'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, active year-round resort campground with tenting sites, hot pool access, and mountain biking/hiking on-site — clear value to touring cyclists on the Trans-Canada corridor between Shuswap and Revelstoke.

wow_evidence: outdoor hot pools (40°C soak to 8°C cold plunge) open every day of the year
